format.description: Format for the response: simplified or legacy

additional_datastreams_permissions.description: Additional data stream permissions that will be added to the agent policy.

cloud_connector_id.description: ID of the cloud connector associated with this package policy.

cloud_connector_name.description: Transient field for cloud connector name during creation.

create_dataset_templates.description: When true, install dedicated index templates for streams with a custom data_stream.dataset. Defaults to true for input packages, false for integration packages.

name.description: The name of the custom field. Cannot contain spaces.

value.description: The value of the custom field.

condition.description: Agent condition expression to evaluate whether to apply this input.

enabled.description: Enable or disable that input. Defaults to `true` (enabled).

condition.description: Agent condition expression to evaluate whether to apply this stream.

enabled.description: Enable or disable that stream. Defaults to `true` (enabled).

var_group_selections.description: Variable group selections. Maps var_group name to the selected option name within that group.

streams.description: Input streams. Refer to the integration documentation to know which streams are available.

inputs.description: Package policy inputs. Refer to the integration documentation to know which inputs are available.

namespace.description: Policy namespace. When not specified, it inherits the agent policy namespace.

overrides.description: Override settings that are defined in the package policy. The override option should be used only in unusual circumstances and not as a routine procedure.

policy_ids.description: IDs of the agent policies that the package policy will be added to.

supports_agentless.description: Indicates whether the package policy belongs to an agentless agent policy. Deprecated in favor of the Fleet agentless policies API.

supports_cloud_connector.description: Indicates whether the package policy supports cloud connectors.
